title: Alchemical Hydra Guide (Battle Only) (Fire Skip Method) OSRS
summary: A narrated Alchemical Hydra kill showing how Gnomonkey lures the boss onto each coloured pool and uses the fire skip method, which he learned from commenters JampS_TV and Jarvis Strawbridge, to avoid the fire phase entirely. It also shows prayer swapping every three attacks and dodging the poison special.

outline.text: Luring the Hydra onto the red pool and starting with protect from magic
Second phase: luring onto the green pool and dealing with lightning
Third phase: luring next to the blue pool
The fire skip: stepping onto a tile to skip the fire phase
Final phase prayer flicking, poison, and loot
Cleaning up and positioning for the next respawn

claims.text: In the Alchemical Hydra fight Gnomonkey stands on a specific tile after the previous kill so the Hydra respawns lured directly onto the red pool, and starts with protect from magic.
After the Alchemical Hydra's first three attacks in a phase it uses its poison special attack, then begins using ranged.
Gnomonkey snakes around the Hydra in the first phase to keep doing damage while pulling it a little closer.
In the second phase Gnomonkey walks to a particular tile to lure the Hydra onto the green pool, and knows it has been lured correctly when it roars.

In the blue phase, after the Hydra's third attack lightning comes out; Gnomonkey waits for the lightning to get a little closer before running to a tile near the bottom, since running too early gets him hit.
For the third (red) phase Gnomonkey stands on a specific tile that lures the Hydra right next to the blue pool, calling it pretty much the perfect tile.

Fire skip: after three attacks in the red phase the Hydra walks to the middle of the room; as soon as its head moves the player must clip onto a particular tile, which skips the whole fire phase so the player can just stand there.
If the player is not on the fire-skip tile when the Hydra's fire attack starts, the player gets bumped, so Gnomonkey says he cut it a little close on the kill shown.
In the last phase the first prayer to use is the opposite of the last attack received during the fire phase, then the player alternates prayers.
In the final phase the poison comes out after the Hydra's third attack; walk two tiles south to dodge it and then flick alternating prayers.
If the final phase goes nine attacks past the first poison shot, the Alchemical Hydra shoots another poison, but this is rare when the player is potted up.

After a kill Gnomonkey tidies his inventory, picks up what he wants such as restore potions, decants them, then walks to a tile and waits for the Hydra to respawn so it is perfectly lured for the next fight.
This guide originally showcased fire walking, but Gnomonkey reworked and re-uploaded it with the fire skip method after JampS_TV and Jarvis Strawbridge told him about it.
Gnomonkey's description says the Alchemical Hydra gives an average of 230k per run.
